title: Japan 5-year JGB auction (¥2,500bn anticipated) — the quarter's OPENING auction, which sets the 2031-09-20 maturity two other tracked ledgers predict their own events will carry
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes) and parsed cell by cell — its table row reads 'Oct. 14, 2026 | 5-year' with no issue number in parentheses and no href on either the Auction Announcement or the Auction Result cell, so nothing about this auction has been published. (MOF prints the issue number into the calendar row once an auction settles: the September calendar 2609e.htm, fetched the same day, reads '5-year (187)'.) TERMS ARE DUE 2026-10-07 — seven calendar days ahead, holiday-adjusted; 10-07 is a Wednesday business day and Sports Day falls 10-12, clear of the lead. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: ¥2,500bn is the anticipated base case, verified this session from the offering column of MOF's own Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls (492,032 bytes, HTTP 200) — all nine 5-year auctions of 2026 offered ¥2,500bn — and corroborated on the live announcement page for the most recent auction, calendar/announcement/auct20260901e.htm (HTTP 200), which reads 'About 2,500 billion yen'. PATH CORRECTION: the '.../auction/announcement/auct*.htm' form recorded by the proposing ledger 404s today; the working path carries 'calendar/' ('.../auction/calendar/announcement/auct20260901e.htm'), read off the calendar's own hrefs. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Canonical file written 2026-09-10 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, from the single sibling proposal from-jgb-climate-transition-5y-auction-2026-11-02, now shadowed
notes: WHY IT IS TRACKED, in one line: under the auction convention MOF has run since 2018Q3, the FIRST 5-year auction of a calendar quarter opens that quarter's new maturity, and 2026-10-14 is the first auction of 2026Q4 — so this is the print that sets the 2031-09-20 line, and it is the first primary that can settle the maturity predictions two sibling ledgers registered (FT-jgb-5y-auction-2026-11-12-2 and FT-jgb-climate-transition-5y-auction-2026-11-02-2), both of which name this auction as their own kill switch. MEASURED THIS SESSION: first-of-quarter is an opening in 33 of 33 quarters 2018Q3-2026Q3, non-first-of-quarter auctions opened a new maturity 0 times in 66, and every quarter in that window carried exactly one maturity (33/33). The rule is a CONVENTION, not a mechanism — 2010Q1-2018Q1 ran the mirror image (the THIRD auction of the quarter opened, 33/33) and the two regimes are separated by one phase-shift quarter, 2018Q2, in which MOF simply ran issue 135 a third time. THE ANSWER ARRIVES 2026-10-07, NOT ON AUCTION DAY: MOF's announcement page carries the maturity date as a named field (verified on auct20260901e.htm — '3. Maturity Date: June 20, 2031'), so both siblings' maturity kill switches resolve at calendar/announcement/auct20261007e.htm, 36 and 5 days before the auctions they are written against. This auction is also the last regular 5-year before the 2026-10-29/30 BoJ meeting (boj.or.jp's own schedule page, fetched 2026-09-10, marks it an Outlook Report meeting), at D-15 — a position all eight post-convention Q4 openings have shared (D-13 to D-20 from an October Outlook MPM, 8 of 8), and one that this session measured to carry NO auction-quality effect (tail Welch t = -0.26 vs the rest; days-to-MPM vs tail correlates +0.009 over 99 auctions). NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reason every sibling JGB ledger records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Note for whoever reads the corridor: US CPI (confirmed, high) prints the same day, as do a Bund 30-year and the Beige Book, and both the US bond market and JPX are shut on 10-12 at D-2 (Columbus Day / Sports Day).
